all_unknown_row_policy: Reference-only: exclude from supervised minibatches unless a separately specified unsupervised objective is introduced.

input.previous_utterances: zero to two observed turns, chronological order; role USER/ASSISTANT only

long_text: Lexical token counts use Unicode words and punctuation, not MiniLM WordPiece. Tail preservation must be addressed by trainer; head truncation can erase the correction.
mask: False = unknown, stored label must be zero; never treat unknown as a negative.
runtime_projection: input only; never id/group/source/labels/masks or row-provenance

semantic_scope.correction: current explicit repair of earlier text/interpretation
semantic_scope.current_affirm: own current affirmative response, including administrative assent; NEVER payment authority
semantic_scope.current_withdraw: own current withdrawal of previously granted permission; first refusal is not withdrawal
semantic_scope.dispute: own contest of liability, charge or payment record
semantic_scope.proposal: own payment offer, including explicitly conditional proposals
semantic_scope.reported_third_party: reports another speaker; a quotation does not automatically imply own assent
semantic_scope.uncertain: expressed uncertainty or explicitly hypothetical/counterfactual condition
